programme.desc: Female US president Sheridan is killed from a mile by a masterly sniper who leaves no trace. The vice-president, now having succeeded for a short end of term, is contested by her brother, governor Wally Sheridan, who plays the national insecurity card, as the murder is only the first of series of terrorist strikes. Colonel Amos and his team are given a free hand to track down and catch the killer at all cost. Ross Tanner, who is found by a retired couple and lovingly nursed after a bad fall from a helicopter, comes to realize trough serious amnesia he's probably the sniper. Two teams track him down. La Mangouste's commando team kills the couple, tortures him and anyone known to have crossed his path but looses him again. General Carrington tells him his identity is an elaborate fake to intrude the conspiracy which uses the collateral victims at every terrorist strike, all tattooed with Roman numerals, like his XIII.

programme.title: Sorority Wars
programme.desc: Katie Parker (Lucy Hale) and Sara Snow (Phoebe Strole) have been friends since childhood. They enter college together, where Katie is a prized legacy candidate for the Delta sorority, which was co-founded decades ago by her mother, Lutie (Courtney Thorne-Smith) and Summer (Faith Ford), whose own daughter Gwen (Amanda Schull) now leads the Deltas on campus. Events occur during pledge week to cause a rift between Katie and the Deltas, which leaves Sara as a Delta pledge and Katie out in the cold. Katie joins the rival Kappa sorority, and the rivalry splits not just Katie and Sara, but extends all the way into the Delta alumnae association led by Lutie and Summer.

programme.title: For One Night
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story of an African American teenager who shook up a small town where high school proms had been racially segregated for decades. Amid the protests of the community and with the help of a newspaper reporter who returns to her hometown to cover the story, the two women are able to reverse decades of racist tradition and make history, at least for one night. The movie is based on events that occurred in Taylor County, Georgia in 2002.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Vanishing Act
programme.desc: Frank Darnell, director of the Central Security Agency (CSA), is at a loss when Miles Crandall, the genius who writes top-secret satellite communication software for his Pentagon-contracted company, disappears from a private jet flight, apparently by parachute, over the desert. CSA vet Cathy Davis, who retired to be a mother to husband Jack ad their kids, is secretly called in to solve the riddle, ironic given her cover as game designer for the US Puzzle Co. They soon realize the escape was staged, the question remains by whom and why. Meanwhile, Nick an unpopular bright nerd runs for class secretary, his haughty sister Susan fails to join the cheerleaders.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Now You See It, Now You Don't
programme.desc: Mystery with Lea Thompson. When the Declaration Of Independence is stolen while on display in a Los Angeles bank, puzzle solver Jane Doe is asked to help solve the case.

programme.desc: When Mark goes for a visit with his uncle he's thrown into a world he knows not much about. Little does he know it'll be a world he's going to have to become very familiar with. One character Mark becomes very familiar and friendly with is a very tame black bear who he later names Ben.

programme.title: Gentle Ben 2: Black Gold
programme.desc: Drama, with Dean Cain. Ranger Jack finds himself in prison after butting heads with Fog, who plans to drill for oil in his reserve, leaving Ben and Mark to come to the rescue.

programme.title: Children Of Dune
programme.desc: As conspiracies to gain political power abound, Paul's power base is eroded from within and his highly ambitious sister, Alia is gaining a political foothold. Born aware of her ancestral memories, Alia is considered an abomination by the Bene Gesserit. The Lady Jessica, her mother returns to Dune (Arrakis) to visit her grandchildren Leto II and Ghanima. When one particular ancestor begins to possess Alia, Lady Jessica has to take refuge. Leto II and Ghanima devise a plan toward salvation.

programme.title: The Ten Commandments
programme.desc: One of the most famous stories from The Bible, this mini-series sees the Hebrew infant, Moses, being raised in the Egyptian royal household. When his true identity is revealed, he sets out to reclaim his heritage. Later, the plagues descend on Egypt, and Pharaoh frees the Hebrews only to change his mind and pursue them to the Red Sea where the parting of the waves ensures their escape. After receiving the Ten Commandments, Moses faces an orgy of excess amongst his tribe.

The oldest daughter sends a letter to her estranged, very wealthy grandmother urging her assistance, much to her mother's disapproval. When the grandmother arrives, old wounds are opened but eventually healed. From a story by Louisa May Alcott. Stars Jacqueline Bisset, Ted Atherton, Tatiana Maslany, Helene Joy, Paula Boudreau, and Michael Barbuto.

programme.title: The Virgin Queen
programme.desc: Elizabeth remains a threat in her childless Catholic sister's eyes. Queen Mary is still on the throne and with her harsh politics, she excessively pursues the persecution of Protestants, even of her sister. Queen Mary knows that her sister has a large number of supporters in England, and therefore, she imprisons Elizabeth in the tower and later puts her under house arrest. When Queen Mary surprisingly dies from a tumor, Elizabeth becomes Queen of England. William Cecil, her advisor, warns Elizabeth of the dangers that the married Robert Dudley may, due to their inappropriate relation, cause as a member of the Privy Council.

programme.title: The Virgin Queen
programme.desc: The Virgin Queen explores the full sweep of Elizabeth's life: from her days of fear as a potential victim of her sister's terror; through her great love affair with Robert Dudley; into her years of triumph over the Armada; and finally her old age and her last, enigmatic relationship with her young protégé, the Earl of Essex.

programme.title: LaLiga. "Barcelona" - "Rayo Vallecano"
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.desc: The bidding is live at the large animal auction! The Pol's are working towards their goal of bringing home sheep and cows to their farm. Meanwhile, Beth and Charles are concerned about the low activity in their beehives.

programme.title: Eternal Enemies: Lions And Hyenas (Revealed)
programme.desc: The Joubert's Emmy winning film is back with stunning remastered footage. Propelled by Jeremy Irons gripping narration, Eternal Enemies reveals the story of conflict between lions and hyenas, relatively unknown or even suspected in the scientific world before this. The intense relationship and enduring rivalry between the two species play out in a battle of survival. Narrated by Jeremy Irons.

programme.title: Borneo's Secret Kingdom: Weird And Wild
programme.desc: Flowing from the heart of Borneo, the Kinabatangan River is a cornucopia of life. From deep within mountains, to its ultimate meeting with the sea. Borneo stands at a triple junction of three tectonic plates, and at the crossroads of two oceans. The river is home to 50 mammal species, 200 types of bird, and countless insects. Fuelled by yearly monsoons, at its headwaters, mountains have sustained wet tropical forests. In the floodplains below, strange and more unexpected life inhabits the dense jungle. Beyond lie tangled mangroves nursing the next generation of marine creatures. Finally, at the cusp of the Sulu Sea the journey begins again. In the tropical warmth, moisture evaporates, rises to form clouds, and on mountain ranges rain falls again.

programme.title: Big Cat Games
programme.desc: The world's most ferocious land predators are pitted against each other in a series of challenges that push them to their limits.

programme.title: Big Cat Planet
programme.desc: Big cats may seem like the ultimate wildlife cliche, but they're locked in a global battle for survival. Powerful and dangerous, they now clash with humans more than ever. This sweeping safari reveals their resilience and adaptability. Cheetahs hunt from cars, jaguars stalk prey underwater and around boats, and India's lions prowl city streets. Familiar species and behaviors take on new drama, with revelations that reaffirm why big cats remain nature's most formidable predators.

programme.title: Cecil: The Legacy of A King
programme.desc: In the heart of Zimbabwe's Hwange National Park, beneath towering mahogany and mopani trees, roamed one of Africa's most legendary lions-Cecil. Known for his immense size and regal presence, he was a dominant force in the wild long before his tragic fate at the hands of hunters made global headlines. While his death sparked international outrage, Cecil: The Legacy of a King shifts the focus to his extraordinary life. A warrior, a father, and a leader, Cecil's story is one of strength, survival, and the bonds that define a pride. This documentary honors the legacy of a lion who was more than just a symbol-he was a king.

programme.title: Desert Lions: Surviving At Skeleton Coast
programme.desc: In this true story, lion researcher Dr. Philip Stander follows three orphaned lion cubs from birth to adulthood as they navigate the complexity of survival in one of the world's most unforgiving environments, Namibia's deadly Skeleton Coast. He gets up close and personal to unlock secrets of their world and witness the amazing adaptability of these special cats.

programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. programme.desc: Born to Summer, queen of a powerful pride, timid lion cub Kio enters a world where every lesson comes at a potential price. One day he may rule a kingdom of his own, but first he must learn to survive. When a buffalo hunt ends in tragedy, Kio gets his first glimpse at how unpredictable life on the savannah can be. As he slowly grows braver, each new challenge pushes him further from the safety of the pride until one solo adventure brings him directly into the path of the pride's greatest enemy: the buffalo.

programme.title: Born in Africa
programme.desc: Born in Africa is a documentary following the stories of newborns in five animal families in the African savanna, from their first steps to the moment they become independent. These little lions, cheetahs, hyenas, meerkats and jackals must face many challenges along the way, as their mothers do everything to protect them in these most vulnerable stages of life. Watch them as they grow and learn how to move and get by in the wilderness in this intimate portrayal of family dynamics in the natural world.

programme.title: An Elephant's World
programme.desc: Confronted by fire, famine, predators, and poachers, three elephant families overcome adversity in ways that feel almost human in nature. This documentary will follow the journeys of elephant herds in Kenya, India, and Mali as they migrate towards food and safety, using knowledge shared over generations. As we look into the minds of elephants, we see that their unique abilities to communicate, educate, and sympathize provide them with the necessary skills to survive. Yet, despite the strength and intelligence of these majestic creatures, humans are causing elephant populations to plummet around the world.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: After getting the tractor stuck in mud, Charles and Ben need a quick solution to plant hayseed in their field to provide food for their incoming animals. The Pol family must quickly figure out why their field is so wet even though it hasnt rained in days. Meanwhile, Dr. Pol helps Charles and Beth set up their first beehive colonies on the new farm.

programme.title: Untamed Americas
programme.desc: Stunning HD cinematography produces an epic yet intimate journey through America's deserts. Everything in the desert lives and dies at the mercy of water. Dry, inhospitable wilderness, they are among the harshest, most extreme environments on the planet. Wind and water sculpt these thirst-lands into natural monuments… as unique as they are spectacular. But look closer and the desert reveals a SECRET WORLD of INTRIGUE… surprising stories of survival, epic perseverance… and things you've never seen before. All of America's deserts provide something… a hidden bounty for those who know where to find it… and how to use it. Title Final Yes.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: This family farm needs a barn! The Pols are ready to tackle their next big project: preserving and carefully taking down a 100-year-old barn since, with every piece they remove makes the barn weaker and weaker. There is no room for error if they are going to transport these irreplaceable beams back to the farm and restore it to its former glory.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pols have reached the most dangerous stage of disassembling the 100-year-old barn: taking down the beams. Then, if all goes well, theyll transport the beams back to the farm. Each part of this process must be carefully orchestrated to protect these irreplaceable beams. Meanwhile, Beth tries training Clovis after he runs away from the farm.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Animals wage a covert war for survival, deploying their hidden weapons with deadly precision. These adaptations, forged by eons of evolution, give animals the edge they need to outwit predators, rivals, and the elements. From the bombardier beetle's boiling spray to the mantis shrimp's explosive club and the draco lizard's hidden wings, meet nature's awesome secret weapons.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators
programme.desc: If you're a forest predator, success requires using trees to bridge the gap between life and death. In this realm, danger - or your next meal - could be behind you, below, or above you. Whether you're a Harpy eagle, zeroing in on prey from high in the rainforest canopy, a cunning weasel, scouring for a meal in and out of mossy logs, or a Bengal tiger, trying to stalk in a bare, dry forest, catching prey among the trees is a challenge.

programme.title: American Amazon
programme.desc: Secret Rivers. Take a journey into the secret wilderness of North America. Under the spell of legendary Southern waterways, follow the pulse of water as it tumbles from precipitous Appalachian highlands.

Cheetahs and secretary birds must conquer extreme heat and elusive prey, risking their lives to feed their offspring. Mongolian wolves hunt for scarce food on the steppe.

programme.desc: Animals survive by using camouflage, mimicry, and stealth tactics. From tigers who hunt in plain sight using their orange fur as camouflage, and a spider who mimics an ant to sneak into a colony, to a bird that uses false alarm calls to trick meerkats into giving up their prey, nature deploys remarkable deception to survive.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: The Alps are changing, not in dramatic leaps but in slow, steady shifts. Rising temperatures and decades of human activity are transforming this once-stable mountain region. Ibex, marmots and ptarmigans each face their own challenges in the alpine world, but with change comes new opportunities. How will the different species adapt? In the valleys, the altered flow of rivers threatens bird species that nest on open gravel. Experience a fragile world in motion.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: Europe's mountains may offer incredible views, but they are rarely an easy place to live. Golden eagles must soar high over the Alps to find food, while stags in the Scottish Highlands battle it out for valuable grazing land. Kidnapping is rife among Gibraltar's Barbary macaques, and - in Norway's high plateaus - musk oxen can't escape the harsh merciless winter. Faced with rugged landscapes and extreme weather conditions, Europe's high-altitude animals must either adapt… or die trying.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines: Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. A nation of more than 100 million people on a collection of over 7,600 islands all set in the warm emerald seas of the Pacific Ocean, the Philippines is a land of sparkling wonder and contrasts.

programme.title: Big Little Giants
programme.desc: Set in Botswana's vast and untamed wilderness, "Big Little Giants" follows Africa's youngest animals as they take their first steps into a challenging world shaped by drought, predators and ancient migration routes. From a newborn elephant learning to keep pace with its herd to jackal pups testing their instincts and cheetah cubs preparing for life at astonishing speed, each story unfolds through intimate moments of learning and loss. Guided by parents, siblings and instinct, these young animals must quickly adapt or fall behind. Through stunning landscapes and close-up encounters, discover how courage, family bonds and resilience shape survival during the most fragile stage of life in the wild.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's new livestock aren't potty trained; their sheep hut isn't draining properly and has now been transformed into a Pee Palace. It's late fall and the winter deep freeze is just around the corner, so the family needs to get it fixed fast. The Pol's also get a new sheep for their farm.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol clan gets to work on creating Beth's dream garden. To beat the incoming rainstorm, an exhausted Ben works around the clock to finish building the garden's pond and waterfall. Noticing her brother is near his breaking point, Beth plans a special surprise to lift his spirits.

programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms of China
programme.desc: China is the world's third biggest country by area. It has second largest economy on the planet and the largest population. But this documentary series takes you away from China's highly-populated mega-cities and explores the more remote locations of this fascinating country. Visiting forests, jungles, mountains and grasslands, we take a rare glimpse at parts of China that usually remain unseen. We see the wildlife that live amongst the stunning beauty of the Chinese landscapes - and how they survive in often demanding situations. With golden snub-nosed monkeys, bears, bees, elephants and the legendary giant panda. The Hidden Kingdoms of China is narrated by Michelle Yeoh.

programme.title: Nature's Nurseries - The Next Wild Generation
programme.desc: Across the world, every species faces the same challenge: giving the next generation the best possible start. From gardens and farms to open fields and remote coastlines, animals raise their young in environments shaped by opportunity and risk. Sparrows and storks build homes alongside humans, making use of food and shelter, while butterflies depend on precise plant life to sustain their offspring. In open landscapes, skylarks nest far from disturbance, relying on camouflage and timing. In harsher climates, survival demands even more adaptation. Puffins time their chicks' arrival to brief seasons of abundance, while musk oxen shield newborns from freezing winds. Through intimate stories and striking settings, these journeys reveal how instinct, environment and resilience shape life's earliest and most vulnerable moments.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: Europe's mountains may offer incredible views, but they are rarely an easy place to live. Golden eagles must soar high over the Alps to find food, while stags in the Scottish Highlands battle it out for valuable grazing land. Kidnapping is rife among Gibraltar's Barbary macaques, and - in Norway's high plateaus - musk oxen can't escape the harsh merciless winter. Faced with rugged landscapes and extreme weather conditions, Europe's high-altitude animals must either adapt… or die trying.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: One Continent - Five Worlds. From the frozen glaciers of Iceland to the lush islands of the Azores, and from the rugged peaks of the Caucasus to the metropolis of London, the first episode in this stunning series highlights Europe's astonishing diversity.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms of China
programme.desc: China is the world's third biggest country by area. It has second largest economy on the planet and the largest population. But this documentary series takes you away from China's highly-populated mega-cities and explores the more remote locations of this fascinating country. Visiting forests, jungles, mountains and grasslands, we take a rare glimpse at parts of China that usually remain unseen. We see the wildlife that live amongst the stunning beauty of the Chinese landscapes - and how they survive in often demanding situations. With golden snub-nosed monkeys, bears, bees, elephants and the legendary giant panda. The Hidden Kingdoms of China is narrated by Michelle Yeoh.

programme.title: Seen on Safari
programme.desc: Safari action is unpredictable, unexpected and utterly raw. A lion captures birds midair, a baboon steals a leopard cub, a hyena plays tug-of-war with a crocodile, and a terrapin chases a lion away from his waterhole. Heroes and underdogs swap roles as nature's heartbreak can turn breathtaking in an instant. On safari, you'll witness nature's most astonishing characters.

programme.title: Seen on Safari
programme.desc: 50 baboons fight a hungry leopard, and an elephant family pulls together to save the smallest in the herd. As the dry season peaks, heading out on safari means checking any remaining waterholes. A leopard hunts bizarre fish in the mud while baboons raid nests on the riverbank. Each event is unpacked and explained, offering a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Jaguars vs. Crocs
programme.desc: Veteran wildlife photographer Steve Winter and cameraman Bertie Gregory capture the remarkable lives of Jaguars in the Pantanal of Brazil. A mother jaguar teaches her cub survival while a determined male jaguar named Scarface dives headfirst into the river to tackle the deadliest of opponents - 6-foot long caiman. Clever capybaras and playful giant otters stick with their family members to avoid being jaguar dinner.

programme.title: 9/11: The Plane That Hit The Pentagon
Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Action-packed animation. Four pizza-loving brothers, Raph, Leo, Donnie and Mikey, are mutant turtles who live in the sewers under the streets of New York City. Raph is the oldest of the brothers and also their leader. Leo is the sword-swinging trickster of the team. Donnie is the smartest of the group and Mikey is the youngest brother and also the joker of the bunch. The adventures they go on help them discover their mystic ninja powers and understand the world around them. They learn to work better as a team of heroes. Skills they will need when faced with the enemies who wish to defeat the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles.

programme.title: T.U.F.F. Puppy
programme.desc: Cold Fish:The deranged Caped Cod has escaped and vows to destroy Petropolis by melting a giant Ice bird Iceberg for the Riceberg Wedding and flooding the city! Dudley's not sure who the real enemy is - the Caped Cod or the pants Dudley has to wear to stay warm enough to defeat him! Lie Like a Dog: While playing hooky from work, Dudley does some pretty heroic things but can't take credit for them without admitting he's been lying!

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: After Katara attempts to teach Aang waterbending, she is desperate to improve her abilities. When Katara inadvertently stumbles across a waterbending scroll that can help improve her ability while Aang is looking at a pirate's store, she decides to steal it after she realizes that she couldn't hope to afford it; but will she be capable of stealing from the pirates without causing herself and her friends trouble?

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Accidents Will Happen: When Squidward gets hurt on the job, he threatens to take legal action unless Mr. Krabs agrees to cater to him hand and foot. Mr. Krabs and Plankton find a common enemy in the popular new "Flabby Patty" restaurant. Drive Thru: Instead of paying to patch up a hole in the wall of the Krusty Krab, Mr. Krabs decides to use it to make more money by turning it into a drive-thru window. Tony Fast, Jr., the son of a famous race car driver, teaches SpongeBob how to drive.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Beekeeper
programme.desc: Jason Statham in un action-thriller sulla vendetta con Josh Hutcherson e Jeremy Irons. Dopo aver subito una truffa, Eloise si suicida, ma il suo vicino Clay decide di vendicarla.

programme.desc: Marco Giallini e Alessandro Gassmann nella commedia d'esordio di Edoardo Falcone. Un cardiochirurgo ateo entra in crisi quando il figlio annuncia di voler diventare sacerdote.

programme.title: La leggenda di Al, John e Jack
programme.desc: New York, 1959. Un noto malavitoso commissiona a tre gangster l'eliminazione di un certo Frankie. Questi sono però tipi decisamente curiosi e, come se non bastasse, uno di loro, in seguito ad un avvenimento traumatico, perde la memoria.

programme.title: Il dio dell'amore
programme.desc: In una realtà sospesa tra sogno e quotidiano, il film esplora i confini del sentimento più puro. Un viaggio onirico e poetico che mette a nudo la fragilità umana di fronte alla forza travolgente del destino.

programme.title: Trespass - Sequestrati
programme.desc: Thriller di Joel Schumacher con Nicolas Cage e Nicole Kidman. Una banda di criminali sequestra 2 coniugi nella loro villa. La lunga notte di violenza farà affiorare segreti inconfessabili.

programme.title: A Star Is Born

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano su alcune delle migliori pellicole del regista premio Oscar che ha fatto e continua a far sognare generazioni di spettatori.

programme.title: Lettere da Iwo Jima
programme.desc: Un Oscar e un Golden Globe alla pellicola di Clint Eastwood che, dopo "Flags of Our Fathers", torna ad affrontare la battaglia di Iwo Jima ma questa volta dal punto di vista giapponese.

programme.title: La stranezza
programme.desc: 4 David di Donatello al film di Roberto Andò con Toni Servillo affiancato dal duo comico Ficarra e Picone. Sicilia, 1920: l'incontro con due scapestrati becchini con la vocazione per il teatro ispira a Luigi Pirandello la stesura di "Sei personaggi in cerca d'autore".

programme.title: Emily
programme.desc: Frances O'Connor esordisce alla regia con il biopic sull'autrice di 'Cime tempestose', interpretata da Emma Mackey. L’equilibrio della famiglia Bronte è scosso dall’arrivo del nuovo Pastore.

programme.title: Edison - L'uomo che illumino' il mondo
programme.desc: Benedict Cumberbatch, Tom Holland e Michael Shannon nel biopic su Thomas Edison. L'avvincente storia del pioniere dell'industria elettrica che ha cambiato la vita degli esseri umani.

programme.title: Stranizza d'amuri
programme.desc: Esordio alla regia di Giuseppe Fiorello. Sicilia, anni 80: due adolescenti, Gianni e Nino, sono costretti a tenere segreto il sentimento che li lega a causa dei pregiudizi contro l'omosessualità.

programme.title: J. Edgar
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio nell'ennesimo capolavoro di Clint Eastwood, che entra nel cuore della storia americana raccontando la chiacchierata vita di J. Edgar Hoover: leggendario capo dell'FBI per quasi 50 anni, dal 1924 al 1972, sotto ben otto presidenti degli Stati Uniti. Il ritratto pubblico e privato di un uomo, e della sua strenua lotta contro la criminalità e il mondo dei gangster. Un uomo, considerato il più potente d'America, che non si fermò davanti a nulla pur di proteggere il proprio Paese. Anche a costo di infrangere ogni regola, scritta e non.

programme.title: Barry Seal - Una storia americana
programme.desc: Tom Cruise e Domhnall Gleeson in un action tratto da una storia vera. Un pilota accusato di narcotraffico viene reclutato dalla Cia per svolgere missioni sotto copertura in Centro America.

programme.title: Il professore e il pinguino
programme.desc: Un insegnante di inglese disilluso si reca in Argentina nel 1976 per insegnare. Si trova di fronte a una classe di ragazzi turbolenti e a un Paese nel caos. Quando salva un pinguino da una spiaggia inquinata dal petrolio, tutto cambia.

programme.title: Kursk
programme.desc: Thomas Vinterberg ricostruisce la storia vera del sottomarino russo affondato nel mare di Barents nell'estate del 2000. Con Léa Seydoux, Colin Firth, Matthias Schoenaerts e Max von Sydow.

programme.title: Red Joan
programme.desc: Judi Dench nella storia di una spia del KGB. Sottoposta a interrogatorio, l'insospettabile vedova Joan Stanley ripercorre la sua lunga militanza al servizio del regime comunista.

programme.title: J. Edgar
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio nell'ennesimo capolavoro di Clint Eastwood, che entra nel cuore della storia americana raccontando la chiacchierata vita di J. Edgar Hoover: leggendario capo dell'FBI per quasi 50 anni, dal 1924 al 1972, sotto ben otto presidenti degli Stati Uniti. Il ritratto pubblico e privato di un uomo, e della sua strenua lotta contro la criminalità e il mondo dei gangster. Un uomo, considerato il più potente d'America, che non si fermò davanti a nulla pur di proteggere il proprio Paese. Anche a costo di infrangere ogni regola, scritta e non.

programme.title: Il sol dell'avvenire
programme.desc: Successo di pubblico e critica per il film di Nanni Moretti con Margherita Buy, Silvio Orlando e Barbora Bobulova. La crisi personale di un regista si intreccia con il film che sta girando.

programme.title: We Are Marshall
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Charlie's Angels", un'emozionante storia vera con Matthew McConaughey. Dopo un tragico incidente, un allenatore fa di tutto per ricostruire la squadra di football.

programme.title: Il Concorso
programme.desc: Keira Knightley e Gugu Mbatha-Raw nel biopic su una storica battaglia femminista. Londra, 1970: il ‘Women's Liberation Movement’ irrompe in diretta televisiva durante il concorso per l’elezione di Miss Mondo in segno di protesta contro la strumentalizzazione delle donne.

programme.title: Barry Seal - Una storia americana
programme.desc: Tom Cruise e Domhnall Gleeson in un action tratto da una storia vera. Un pilota accusato di narcotraffico viene reclutato dalla Cia per svolgere missioni sotto copertura in Centro America.

programme.title: Il texano dagli occhi di ghiaccio
programme.desc: Leggendario western diretto e interpretato da Clint Eastwood. Alla fine della Guerra di Secessione, una banda di nordisti si accanisce contro un contadino sudista e la sua famiglia.

programme.title: The Company Men
programme.desc: Dramma sociale con Ben Affleck, Kevin Costner e Tommy Lee Jones. La vita di un agiato impiegato americano subisce un netto ridimensionamento quando perde il lavoro a causa della Recessione.

programme.title: Ammazzare stanca
programme.desc: La storia vera di Antonio Zagari, figlio di un boss della 'ndrangheta calabrese trapiantata in Lombardia. Nei primi anni '70 Antonio sviluppa un'avversione fisica per la violenza e decide di ribellarsi alla tradizione criminale di famiglia.

programme.title: Il sol dell'avvenire
programme.desc: Successo di pubblico e critica per il film di Nanni Moretti con Margherita Buy, Silvio Orlando e Barbora Bobulova. La crisi personale di un regista si intreccia con il film che sta girando.

programme.title: November - I cinque giorni dopo il Bataclan
programme.desc: Jean Dujardin nella pellicola che ricostruisce le indagini sugli attentati del 2015. Fred, un poliziotto dell'antiterrorismo, deve trovare i fuggitivi più ricercati di Francia.

programme.title: Quasi amici
programme.desc: Omar Sy e François Cluzet nella commedia campione d'incassi. Un miliardario paralizzato stringe una grande amicizia con il suo badante: un ragazzo senegalese appena uscito dal carcere.

programme.title: Sotto attacco
programme.desc: Stephen Dorff sale sul ring in un action-drama dallo sceneggiatore di "American History X". Diventato campione di MMA come reazione a un padre violento, Cash si ritrova a gestire un figlio che vuole seguire le sue orme e la nascita di un bambino affetto da una rara sindrome.

programme.title: Giu' la testa
programme.desc: Western restaurato di Sergio Leone con James Coburn e Rod Steiger. Un fuorilegge messicano si allea con un rapinatore irlandese e si trova a combattere per la Rivoluzione di Villa e Zapata.

programme.title: Lee Miller
programme.desc: Racconto intenso sulla vita della fotografa Lee Miller, che esplora il costo emotivo del suo lavoro e il coraggio necessario per documentare la realtà brutale della guerra.

programme.title: What They Had
programme.desc: Hilary Swank e Michael Shannon in un dramma familiare. Tornata nella casa di Chicago per gestire la malattia della madre, Bridget è costretta a fare i conti con rancori mai sopiti.

programme.title: Apollo 13
programme.desc: 2 Oscar alla pellicola di Ron Howard con Tom Hanks sulla sfortunata missione spaziale. 1970: il viaggio verso la Luna della navicella Apollo 13 viene interrotto da un'esplosione.

programme.title: Il sol dell'avvenire
programme.desc: Successo di pubblico e critica per il film di Nanni Moretti con Margherita Buy, Silvio Orlando e Barbora Bobulova. La crisi personale di un regista si intreccia con il film che sta girando.

programme.title: Non ci resta che piangere
programme.desc: Un maestro elementare e un bidello si ritrovano, per uno strano scherzo del caso, nel 1492. Decidono di recarsi a Palos, in Andalusia, per fermare Cristoforo Colombo e impedirgli di scoprire le Americhe.

programme.title: The Untouchables - Gli intoccabili
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sean Connery, nel capolavoro di Brian De Palma con Kevin Costner e Robert De Niro. Chicago, 1930: una squadra speciale viene incaricata di incastrare Al Capone.

programme.title: Quei bravi ragazzi
programme.desc: Robert De Niro e Ray Liotta in un capolavoro di Martin Scorsese, miglior regia a Venezia. Lo spietato mondo della mafia newyorkese raccontato da un gangster pentito. Oscar a Joe Pesci.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Golden Globe a Leonardo DiCaprio nel biopic di Martin Scorsese con Margot Robbie. L'incredibile ascesa di Jordan Belfort, un broker attratto dalla sete di potere e da una vita dissoluta.

programme.title: Honey Don't!
programme.desc: Ethan Coen dirige una sensuale Margaret Qualley, detective privata fuori dagli schemi di un intrigante noir ambientato in California.

programme.title: No Other Choice - Non c'è altra scelta
programme.desc: Le contraddizioni della società coreana nel film di Park Chan-wook presentato a Venezia. Licenziato dopo 25 anni, un uomo vede andare in frantumi la sua vita "perfetta".

programme.title: Bones and All
programme.desc: Leone d'Argento a Luca Guadagnino che dirige Taylor Russell, Timothee Chalamet e Mark Rylance. L'intenso viaggio di due anime affini nell'America degli anni '80.

programme.title: Saint Judy
programme.desc: Michelle Monaghan nella vera storia di Judy Wood, l'avvocato che ha cambiato la legge sul diritto d'asilo negli Usa. Assunta in uno studio di Los Angeles, si batte per una donna afgana.

programme.title: Romanzo criminale
programme.desc: Michele Placido dirige Favino, Rossi Stuart, Accorsi, Scamarcio, Santamaria, Fresi e Germano per raccontare ascesa e caduta della Banda della Magliana nell'Italia degli anni 70.

programme.title: Invictus - L'invincibile
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige Morgan Freeman e Matt Damon in un biopic sportivo. Sudafrica, 1995. Per il presidente Mandela, la coppa del mondo di rugby è l'occasione per unire bianchi e neri.

programme.title: Quei bravi ragazzi
programme.desc: Robert De Niro e Ray Liotta in un capolavoro di Martin Scorsese, miglior regia a Venezia. Lo spietato mondo della mafia newyorkese raccontato da un gangster pentito. Oscar a Joe Pesci.

programme.title: Father Mother Sister Brother
programme.desc: I membri di tre famiglie distanti si riuniscono: un fratello e una sorella fanno visita all'eccentrico padre, le due figlie di una scrittrice confrontano la madre davanti a una tazza di tè, due gemelli devono gestire l'appartamento dei genitori.

programme.title: Padrenostro
programme.desc: Coppa Volpi a Pierfrancesco Favino, diretto da Claudio Noce in una storia ispirata alla sua vita. Roma, 1976: Valerio assiste all'attentato terroristico ai danni del padre magistrato.

programme.title: I figli degli uomini
programme.desc: Sci-Fi distopico di Alfonso Cuaron, con Clive Owen, Julianne Moore e Michael Caine. 2027: un ex attivista protegge l'unica donna rimasta incinta in un'umanita' colpita dall'infertilita'.

programme.title: Bones and All
programme.desc: Leone d'Argento a Luca Guadagnino che dirige Taylor Russell, Timothee Chalamet e Mark Rylance. L'intenso viaggio di due anime affini nell'America degli anni '80.

programme.title: La stanza accanto
programme.desc: Tilda Swinton e Julianne Moore in un dramma di Pedro Almodovar, Leone d'Oro a Venezia. Martha è una reporter di guerra malata di cancro che ha deciso di suicidarsi con una pillola. Ingrid, una sua amica di infanzia, passa con lei gli ultimi giorni prima del momento fatale.

programme.title: Per qualche dollaro in piu'
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo restaurato della trilogia western di Sergio Leone con Clint Eastwood e Gian Maria Volontè. Due pistoleri braccano un bandito messicano sul quale pende una grossa taglia.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si raccontano le migliori pellicole del leggendario Clint Eastwood disponibili da sabato 13 a venerdì 19 settembre su Sky Cinema Collection.

programme.title: Piccole donne
programme.desc: Rilettura di un classico diretto da Greta Gerwig con Saoirse Ronan, Emma Watson, Laura Dern e Meryl Streep. La storia delle sorelle March nell'America della Guerra Civile. Oscar ai costumi.

Un giorno assiste a un incidente aereo e scopre che il pilota è un essere umano: una specie da sempre considerata un’invenzione. Un bambino di 10 anni scopre di essere l'incarnazione di una divinità, dotato di poteri straordinari e con una missione da predestinato: fermare la sanguinosa guerra che oppone da un secolo la Nazione del Fuoco ai regni di Acqua, Aria e Terra. Adattamento della serie a cartoni "Avatar - la leggenda di Aang", doveva essere il primo film di una trilogia, poi mai realizzata. Formidabile la fotografia di Andrew Lesnie, premio Oscar per "Il signore degli anelli - La compagnia dell'anello".

programme.title: Stolen
programme.desc: Simon West ('Con Air') dirige Nicolas Cage in un action con Josh Lucas e Malin Akerman. Durante una rapina qualcuno lo ha tradito, cosi' Will Montgomery si e' fatto qualche anno di carcere. Il bottino non e' mai stato recuperato, ma il suo vecchio socio e' convinto che Will sappia dove sia finito. E per recuperarlo ha un solo modo per convincerlo a collaborare: rapisce sua figlia Allison e la tiene prigioniera nel bagagliaio di un taxi. Se vuole rivedere la ragazza sana e salva, Will deve trovare 10 milioni di dollari in 12 ore.

Le sue dimensioni, inoltre, aumentano a dismisura. Un esperto di scimmie, Davis Okoye, che aveva stretto un affettuoso rapporto con il primate, vuole vederci chiaro. Indagando sull'accaduto scopre che altri animali sono stati sottoposti allo stesso trattamento. Un lupo e un coccodrillo stanno andando incontro alla medesima alterazione di George: serve al più presto un antidoto per fermare la loro rabbia distruttrice.

Sequel in versione femminile della trilogia formata da "Ocean's Eleven - Fate il vostro gioco', "Ocean's Twelve' e "Ocean's Thirteen', diretta da Steven Soderbergh, qui in veste di produttore.

programme.title: Sapore di mare
programme.desc: Celebre commedia diretta da Carlo Vanzina con Jerry Calà e Christian De Sica. Estate 1964: sulle spiagge della Versilia si intrecciano le vicende di un gruppo di vacanzieri in cerca di avventure, in particolare quelle di Paolo e Marina, due fratelli napoletani, e di Luca e Felicino, fratelli milanesi ricchi e viziati. Amori e avventure in un periodo per molti indimenticabile. Sullo sfondo i successi musicali dei meravigliosi anni 60. David di Donatello e Nastro d’argento come miglior attrice non protagonista a Virna Lisi.

programme.title: Il sesso degli angeli
programme.desc: Leonardo Pieraccioni dirige e interpreta una commedia con Sabrina Ferilli e Marcello Fonte. Un sacerdote di Firenze scopre di aver ereditato una casa di appuntamenti in Svizzera.

programme.title: Pari e dispari
programme.desc: Il guardiamarina Johnny Firpo viene incaricato dai suoi superiori di indagare su una banda di allibratori clandestini operanti in Florida. Dato che egli ignora quasi tutto del gioco, verrà affiancato da qualcuno che, invece, ne sappia.

programme.title: Grazie ragazzi
programme.desc: Antonio Albanese e Vinicio Marchioni in una commedia di Riccardo Milani. Un attore disoccupato accetta di insegnare teatro a una classe di detenuti e mette in scena "Aspettando Godot".

programme.title: Ti ripresento i tuoi
programme.desc: Il regista di "Giu' al Nord", Dany Boon dirige e interpreta una commedia degli equivoci. Un architetto nasconde le sue umili origini, ma un giorno i suoi genitori si presentano a Parigi.

programme.title: Indovina chi viene a Natale?
programme.desc: Commedia natalizia di Fausto Brizzi con Diego Abatantuono e Claudio Bisio. Una famiglia allargata si riunisce per le feste in una località di montagna, scatenando equivoci e incomprensioni.

programme.title: Amore oggi

programme.title: ... altrimenti ci arrabbiamo!
programme.desc: Bud e Kid si vendicano di un criminale i cui scagnozzi hanno distrutto la loro nuova dune buggy. Dietro l'episodio, però, si celano losche manovre per una speculazione edilizia e le scarse capacità di uno psicologo tedesco.

programme.title: Boyette: Not A Girl Yet
programme.desc: A college freshman pretends to be straight in order to get closer to his crush who is homophobe.

programme.title: Maybe This Time
programme.desc: \"Steph Asuncion and Tonio Bugayong were once in love. Back then, she was a young girl who wanted a simple life and he was older, more ambitious than she was. Tonio was a small town guy who wants to board a ship to provide for his family’s furniture business. Sarah was a Manila girl who spends the summer in the province for community service. What might have been a sweet relationship ended sourly when Tonio left without saying goodbye. Steph was heartbroken and it taught her to dream bigger to be worthy of love. Will their paths cross again? Will they overcome the pains of the past to give love a second chance? This is a story between two people who will be reminded about the importance of being true to one’s self in order for true love to happen.\".

programme.title: Exes Baggage
programme.desc: After a chance encounter, Pia and Nix instantly hit it off. Natural conversations eventually develop into deep attraction. Despite their wounds from previous relationships, both decide to take a chance on each other. But when their love blossoms into a relationship, their differences will test their love and will make them question: Are they ready for love when they're still carrying baggage from their past?
